issue_context.title: Make timestamp label width dynamic in background player
issue_context.body:
In live streams and when layouts change, timestamp label's width needs to be dynamic — otherwise it will expand vertically.

![IMG_20190908_131651_359](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11773604/64487432-f44af500-d23a-11e9-9f05-cdf6ad831d94.jpg)

review_comments: The idea behind this is to center the seekbar. After your changes, the seekbar will not be centered. Maybe it is better to detect which of both fields is wider and enlarge the other one.

There is one thing to note: theoretically currentTime width is never bigger than endTime's, so the first 'if' in the code above could be removed.

I think it would be possible to do something using [a table layout](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/6647177/set-equal-width-of-columns-in-table-layout-in-android), but I'm not sure.
